breakdown.description: The pipe is simultaneously described as horizontal/same elevation and having a 15 m elevation difference (contradictory geometry).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the contradiction. The incomplete prompt described the pipe as both horizontal and having a 15m elevation difference. The generated specification removed the 'horizontal' description and correctly stated 'The pipe has an elevation change of 15 meters from inlet to outlet', which aligns with the ground truth's correction.
